thread:
Michelle: Heads-up, saw a noisy autofallback loop on ap-southeast staging cluster this morning. Primary -> fallback -> primary every ~7s for 2 minutes.
Raj: Yup, hit the alert. Root cause looks like a transient spike of model_cache_miss + a downstream 502 cascade.
Lina: If we add a cooldown at the router it reduces noise quickly, but console visibility suffers.
Sam: We should make the cooldown part of the policy so it
ppears in audit snapshots. Otherwise operators can't correlate the action to a rollout config.
Michelle: I like policy-level cooldown + hysteresis. Concrete: require 3 error events in 15s to trigger fallback, require 10 success events in 45s to recover. Add a 2.5s debounce so we don't flip due to microbursts.
Raj: Example policy proto we tried locally:
```json
{ "name": "autofallback_v1", "triggers": [ {"signal": "5xx", "count": 3, "window_sec": 15}, {"signal": "model_cache_miss", "count": 2, "window_sec": 10} ], "recover": {"count": 10, "window_sec": 45}, "debounce_ms": 2500, "operator_facing": true }
```
Lina: UX for console: card shows current active variant + a small reason ("err_rate:5xx, last_flip: 2024-05-08T09:12:33Z"). Clicking opens a timeline flyout with the ring-buffer events and a mini-graph.
Michelle: Add a tiny pill "policy snapshot id" linking to the exact protobuf used at decision time.
Sam: Implementation detail: ensure the ring-buffer uses compressed event tuples like {t,code,latency_bucket}. Keep 30s retention by default with per-customer opt-in to longer retention.
Raj: Telemetry: emit both aggregated counter (fallback.triggered) and a histogram of buffer_fill_time. Also a tag with policy_id and snapshot_hash.
ops-bot: I-2026-200 created by Raj  P2. Traces: https://internal/trace/I-2026-200
Lina: UX mock TODO: place simulation button in the rollout flyout. Allow injecting signals (5xx, latency, cache_miss) to preview behavior. Also show the decision hysteresis slider for quick adjustments.
Michelle: Can we make simulation safe in private deployments? It should be sandboxed to the operator's workspace not the tenant.
Sam: Yes, the dry-run should be executed against a mock router instance. We'll reuse the staging canary.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled to staging at 1723456800 with ring-buffer exporter enabled.
Michelle: Plan: Lina drafts two console mocks (card + flyout), Raj drafts telemetry metrics, Sam wires ring-buffer into router, I'll draft RFC for policy semantics. Prototype by COB next Wednesday.
Lina: Will post Figma and short description in #design by EOD.
Michelle: Thanks team. If anyone sees more flips, tag I-2026-200 and update this thread.
